primary_question: baseline ETOH RNA predicts individual-specific DEX-minus-ETOH residual in unseen biological LCLs

allowed_primary_inputs: authors' official GSE207049 voom_resid processed matrix for the preregistered pilot, with an explicit SVA caveat
author gene counts normalized strictly within each outer training fold
forbidden_primary_inputs: expression residualized using genotype or individual-linked latent factors
features or filters estimated from held-out DEX expression
input_eligibility.published_voom_resid_role: primary pilot plus truth validation, under the user's resource amendment dated 2026-08-22
input_eligibility.reason: the amended protocol explicitly authorizes the authors' official processed matrix for the pilot; all reports must state that three surrogate variables were removed and must not call the input unresidualized baseline RNA

replicate_handling.prediction_aggregation: arithmetic mean of every retained version within LCL and treatment
replicate_handling.cross_fold_rule: all versions of an LCL remain in one outer fold
replicate_handling.truth_replicates: use only LCLs with two independently labelled retained versions in both ETOH and DEX

truth_gate.response: DEX minus ETOH within version, followed by version-specific shared-response centering across replicate-complete LCLs
truth_gate.replicate_global_correlation_gate: bootstrap lower 95% bound greater than zero
truth_gate.genetic_support_gate: at least one DEX-versus-ETOH context-dependent eQTL with LFSR below 0.10 in either environment and posterior effects differing by at least two-fold or sign
truth_gate.continue_rule: both replicate and genetic support gates pass

pilot_if_input_eligible.outer_cv: five-fold ancestry-stratified grouped split by LCL; seed 207049
pilot_if_input_eligible.inner_cv: three-fold ancestry-stratified grouped split by LCL
pilot_if_input_eligible.positive_predictability_pause: pooled OOF residual R2 greater than 0.10

stop_rules.data_integrity_failure: stop before model fitting and issue no Level-2 sufficiency verdict

claim_boundary: No claim of biological RNA insufficiency, transcriptomic identity, information-theoretic impossibility, or impossibility for future models
